content:
Context: 12. Assistance to Government servants in legal proceedings

6. (iv) Cases filed by a Government servant to vindicate his conduct requiring prior sanction of Government.In deserving cases, Government will sanction interest-free advance for the conduct of the proceedings; but no part of the expenses will be reimbursed by the Government even if the Government servant succeeds in the proceedings.  
If permission sought for is not refused within 3 months, the Government  
servant is free to assume that the permission sought for has been granted.
